h1: {name} beside the AI apps you know
lede: Where each one runs, who reads what you send, what it costs, and whether you can leave with your things. And if you’re choosing between ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini: in {name} you don’t have to.

choose.title: ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini? You don’t have to choose.
choose.why: Each does some things better, and the order changes every few months. In {name} you use each where it does best, and switch from the box, task by task.
choose.cards: Free, no sign-up, works offline. Needs 12 GB of memory and a recent graphics chip.
One click, with a free OpenRouter account.
Thirteen services, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Mistral among them.

choose.history: Coming from one of them? Bring your history: ChatGPT’s, Claude’s and Gemini’s exports come in, nothing twice.
one.title: Compared one by one
one.cards: Keep ChatGPT if you like. Your files stay on your device.

catch.title: The catch, plainly
catch.why: Every tool has one. Here is {name}’s.
catch.items: {name} is free; the AI behind it may not be.

faq.title: Questions people ask
faq.items: It can be. It can also be where you use ChatGPT, with your files kept on your device. {name} is the app; the AI is your choice.
Which is best: ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini?
It depends on the task, and it changes often. In {name} you can switch the AI from the box and ask again.
{name} is free and open source. The AI may cost: free on this computer or with a free account, otherwise your key or your plan.

{name} is made in France and open source. Its AI can be European too: Mistral’s with your key, or one on your own computer.
